mechanism: Ketorolac (systemic NSAID) may potentiate brimonidine's ocular hypotensive and systemic hypotensive effects through additive mechanisms, while brimonidine ophthalmic absorption is minimal reducing interaction risk.
action: Monitor blood pressure and intraocular pressure during concurrent use; brimonidine ophthalmic has minimal systemic absorption making clinically significant interaction unlikely but caution advised with systemic ketorolac.
